material_news_signals.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
material_news_signals.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
material_news_signals.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

material_news_signals.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

material_news_signals.headline: Ravens complete trade for Cardinals' Jacoby Brissett; deal terms revealed
material_news_signals.description: The Arizona Cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens, the teams announced Friday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the arizona cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback jacoby brissett to the baltimore ravens the teams announced friday baltimore is sending arizona a 2027 fourth round pick and 2028 seventh rounder in exchange for brissett and a 2027 fifth round selection nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported the cardinals also paid more than half of brissett s remaining 2026 salary as part of the swap per rapoport the trade was initially reported on wednesday with the caveat that it would be finalized later in the week which has come to fruition cardinals head coach mike lafleur spoke to reporters on wednesday and stated he would let the process play out before confirming now the parties have come to terms in the aftermath of the ravens losing to the jacksonville jaguars on thursday night marking the third time in as many games baltimore had a different starting quarterback and its fourth consecutive loss undrafted free agent joe fagnano started against jacksonville after franchise qb lamar jackson started week 8 and injured his thumb on his first play back from missing time with an ankle injury in jackson s stead tyler huntley filled in as the starter but after relieving jackson against the buffalo bills huntley suffered a turf toe injury that has ended his season jackson meanwhile is on injured reserve and out indefinitely now the ravens winding road turns to brissett who presumably will start in week 10 against the los angeles chargers on monday night football brissett began this season his 11th in the nfl as arizona s qb1 he was benched following eight starts in favor of gardner minshew and shortly thereafter his trade to baltimore was reported so far in 2026 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 touchdowns and seven interceptions baltimore stands as his seventh nfl team new england patriots indianapolis colts miami dolphins cleveland browns washington commanders cardinals and will become the sixth for which he s started a game the ravens will look to rescue what s fast becoming a lost season as they owned a 12 playoff probability following thursday s defeat unfortunately for those odds brissett hasn t started a game for a playoff team since his rookie season of 2016 with the patriots the cardinals meanwhile will march forward with minshew starting and rookie carson beck in reserve and perhaps getting a shot later as lafleur s team looks to stay competitive and more importantly build for the future

material_news_signals.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs isn't worrying over whether additional allegations will lead to more punishment
material_news_signals.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs says he isn’t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations.
material_news_signals.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs says he isn t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations that were made against him years before he pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend with all the evidence that we have and that they have at this point it s not one of those things where i m sitting back on my hands like ok am i going to play this week jacobs said wednesday it s like i kind of already know what it is so it s like it s really just up to them to make their final decision but i m not worried about feeling like i m going to miss any more time than i already have after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs has returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar allegations from years before lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations that surfaced in friday s records release they said those allegations are old are hearsay and easily disproven it really feels like an attack on me and who i am and my character jacobs said wednesday and at the end of the day there s a lot of stuff being said about me that s completely false like completely made up and it s like people just run with it and i can t change that it s just one of those thing where it s like ok all i can do is try to be who i am and try not to let the negative moments change who i am and that was the biggest thing for me throughout this whole process i didn t want to go to a place where i felt like i was closed off and i m angry all the time because of what s going on in my life jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl has declined comment on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from the other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation jacobs arrest followed a may 23 incident in which police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police a woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head copyright 2026 by the associated press

team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is material_news_signals.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
material_news_signals.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the material_news_signals.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at
